name: INTRUDERS 👁
desc:
game still in development expect bugs
new updates weekly

you wake up in the attic. the window out is sealed 
four keys. search quietly. it hunts by sound, not by sight, you must navigate the series of connected vents and use sounds to distract something trapped down here. and sometimes that something is one of you.

monster design inspired by Draxxom (instagram).
